name: Blind Rage
body:
You cannot distinguish between friend and foe when you are raging.

Prerequisite: Rage Ability

Benefit: You cannot end your rage voluntarily. You rage for the complete duration and must attack a creature each round, if able. If not then either move towards any visible creature. If no creatures are visible you attack the nearest breakable object. DC 15 Will save each round on your turn to stop yourself attacking an ally. If any foes become visible you can attack them and engage them rather than an ally.
